credits.title: Hinatazaka46's Happy Train Tour 2023 in Osaka Castle Hall
credits.overview: Hinatazaka46 Happy Train Tour 2023 is a tour held by Hinatazaka46. The tour started on August 30th, 2023, and is scheduled to finish on December 10th, 2023.

credits.title: 4th Year Memorial Live
credits.overview: The 4th Year Memorial Live was a Hinatazaka46 concert that took place on April 1-2, 2023 in Yokohama Stadium.

credits.title: HINAKURI 2022
credits.overview: Hinakuri 2022 was a Hinatazaka46 concert held on December 17-18, 2022. It was their fifth Christmas concert (fourth as Hinatazaka46). It was also Miyata Manamo's final concert as a member.
